tagline: 55% of a perfect lineup, and the second-best ceiling in the league.
file: A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
The silence. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.

headline: 2-6, 11th, and a bench that scored 138.48
story: Week 8 was a 164.4 to 114.98 loss to Zygon. Kirk Cousins was the QB of the week at 28.18 and Tyler Allgeier the RB of the week at 36.1, but Joe Burrow's 42.48 was the best QB benchwarmer of the week. The bench scored 138.48, with 93.88 good enough to start, and the lineup was 55% of perfect, the worst of the week.
He is 2-6, 11th, with 978.04 points, 8th in the league. His MAXPF of 1339.8 is the second-highest and moves him ahead of Hades9mm for the 1.11. He did not say a word in the Week 8 chat.
takes: The bench scored more than the starters again.
The second-best ceiling in the league and the worst lineup of the week.
